examples.title: Why was my RSA PKCS#12 key not imported?
Every reason code a verdict can return

description: Explain any code this server can emit, from the registries vendored at the pkinative v1.0.0 tag: the 57 PKI_* engine error codes (coarse class, PkiError subclass, when raised, CWE, the engine's remedy and the MCP input that lifts it), the 43 PKI_REASON_* codes a verdict returns, the 97 PKI_DIAG_* diagnostics (with severity) and the wrapper's own codes (VALIDATION_ERROR, SECURITY_VIOLATION, LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED, SECRET_REQUIRED, …). list:true enumerates (kind filters one vocabulary). Branch on codes, never on message text.

code.description: The code to explain (PKI_*, PKI_REASON_*, PKI_DIAG_* or a wrapper code such as SECURITY_VIOLATION). Omit with list:true to enumerate.

fields.description: Dot-paths to keep after verbosity (arrays map over elements); unmatched paths land in _meta.unmatchedFields.

kind.description: Restrict a listing to one vocabulary.

list.description: List the codes (optionally of one kind) instead of explaining one.

name: explain_code

outputSchema.description: A code explanation, or a listing. Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

errorClass.description: The coarse class (usage, input, parse, security, limit, unsupported, crypto, password, check, internal).

mcp.description: The MCP input that lifts it.

summary.description: When the code is raised / returned.

title: Explain a code (errors, reasons, diagnostics, wrapper codes)
